messages:
Mei: Heads-up — CipherShelf (SI partner) wants to list on the cloud marketplace. Their compliance asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and HSM-backed KMS for BYOK. They're asking what exact artifacts we need to enable a smooth onboarding flow.

Jonah: Nice. For the HSM/KMS piece: we need to know whether they expose KMIP endpoints or provide a cloud-KMS-compatible adapter (e.g., KMS gRPC adapter). Also ask for: key lifecycle doc, support for non-exportable keys, and sample responses for auth failures.

Priya: For SAML: proprietary metadata or raw XML ok. We require entityID, ACS URL, IdP signing cert, and NameID format. For marketplace listing, we also verify SAML SP metadata on our side. Send a sample assertion template if they can.

Priya: SCIM requirements: endpoints (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE), token auth scheme, and example payloads. Minimum attributes: userName (email), active, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails, and groups for role sync. We prefer bulk import + incremental sync.

Carlos: Security checklist items: signed key custody attestation (BYOK vs keys held by vendor), recent penetration test summary, and HSM vendor compliance (FIPS 140-2/3 or equivalent). Marketplace legal will also want proof of node-level encryption and key separation.

Jonah: Quick sample KMIP probe we give partners:

```
# test KMIP Discover
curl -v --cert client.pem --key client.key https://cipher-hsm.example.com:5696/ | head -n 20
```

Jonah: If they don't support KMIP, we accept an envelope-wrapping adapter if it exposes the same semantics (createKey, encrypt/decrypt, rotate). Provide latency numbers for 1k calls/s.

Mei: Good. Also: marketplace requires a cert-rotation plan for any pinned CA we use. If the partner rotates their HSM CA more frequently than 6 months, we need automated thumbprint check + webhook to update.

Priya: Example SCIM PATCH we ask for on initial test:

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/2819c223-7f76-453a-919d-413861904646
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <token>

{"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{"op": "replace", "path":"name.givenName", "value":"Alex"}]}
```

Priya: Also note we map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles via the `groups` attribute. Provide group IDs and sample membership sync.

Carlos: Legal asks: A signed attestation about key custody model and whether customer keys are ever derived/exported. Also SLA bits (RTO/RPO) for HSM gateway. We'll need to add the attestation as part of the marketplace listing artifacts.

Mei: Let's schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 11am PT to finalize the onboarding checklist with CipherShelf and assign follow-ups. @Jonah @Priya @Carlos

integrations-bot: Meeting scheduled: "CipherShelf Marketplace onboarding (SSO/SCIM/HSM)" — Wed 11:00 AM PT — Zoom link sent to calendar. :calendar:

Jonah: I'll draft a short KMS compatibility test plan (KMIP probe + adapter smoke tests) and post to the partnership ticket after the call.

Priya: I'll prepare a SCIM test user bundle and an example SAML assertion (including minimal attributes) for them to use during integration tests.

Carlos: I'll reach out to Legal to prepare the attestation template and to Security to pull FIPS/SOC docs checklist.

Mei: Awesome. Please drop any pre-reads in the ticket and ping me if CipherShelf shares anything before the call. Thanks all. :pray:
